THE_ARCHITECT.talk.FRIERENMOD-FRIEREN.0-: What do you seek in this tower?
I've come to collect more spells.
I'll teach you a spell to put you to [red]sleep[/red]...
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.FRIERENMOD-FRIEREN.1-: You again. Have you not learned to give up?
Let me see your magic once more.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.FRIERENMOD-FRIEREN.2-: I see. I understand your magic now.
It will come in handy next time.
FRIERENMOD-SERIE.title: Serie
FRIERENMOD-SERIE.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
Between the stacks of books, a golden-haired elf looks up.

"...You again, Frieren."
FRIERENMOD-SERIE.pages.DONE.description:
Serie opens her book again.

"Next time, at least bring some worthwhile magic."

"That depends on what I find," you reply.
FRIERENMOD-SERIE.talk.FRIERENMOD-FRIEREN: Frieren... Have you forgotten you're barred from the Magic Association for a thousand years?
Serie, this is the Spire, not the Association. You should get out more.
Hmph. I'm not teaching you any magic. Pick one of these pieces of junk and take it with you.
Frieren, I told you not to come in.
Serie, have you seen the spell that creates a field of flowers?
A field of flowers? Was it Flamme...?
Yes. Humans have such strange interests. They're always giving flowers special meanings.
Enough idle chatter. This junk is an eyesore. Hurry up and take it away.
You really do have quite a collection of treasures here.
I wonder how many centuries it'll be before we meet again.
[i]Serie waves a hand, indicating that you can choose anything and leave.[/i]
FRIERENMOD-SERIE.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: How surprising. Even someone who isn't a mage managed to find this place. You may take one treasure before you leave.
